_notes: THE PROLOGUE, IN ORDER. StoryLoader reads this file, concatenates
`arcs` in the order listed, and merges `interludes` on top -- the
result is exactly the dictionary game.gd used to load from the single
prologue.json, so nothing downstream had to learn a new shape.
Why split: one 23KB file held 33 scenes plus four page-sets, so every
edit touched the same file and no filename told you where a beat was.
An arc is now a file you can open, read end to end, and hand to a
To add an arc: write the file, add it to `arcs` in the right place.
To reorder: move the filename. Scene INDICES shift when you do, and
`--scene story:<index>` counts across the whole prologue -- so a
reorder invalidates any index you had written down.
